newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Heartland buy repeated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Heartland buy repeated.

text.p: - BT Securities repeated a strong buy rating on Heartland Wireless Communications Inc and said a recent decline in the price of the company's stock creates a buying opportunity.

- The share price of Heartland Wireless, which develops, owns and operates wireless cable televison systems, fell by about one third after the company reported third quarter earnings on November 15. BT Securities analyst Mark McFadden said the reaction was not warranted.

- Heartland reported the number of subscribers in the third quarter rose 220 percent from last year. Revenues were off by seven percent from BT Securities estimates but up more than 300 percent over last year.
- Shares of Heartland were trading off 5/8 to 13-1/4.
